getter.windowBoundary: Selected generated getter fast path through its first return; patch branch and adjacent method are outside.

evidenceBoundary.direct: The SurfTileIDs getter and collector use the same inline DataGroup and ByteBuffer carrier. Checked group Index/Num getters feed a bounded grid-local PrimitiveIntList loop. The unregistered indexer clone agrees with the registered generated accessor on vtable slot, vector helper, four-byte stride and selected little-endian Int32 read. Only positive Int32 values are widened to UInt64 and forwarded with the supplied List<UInt64>.Add MethodSpec context to an inline insertion helper. Its checked size/qword insertion and resize target agree with the separately registered generic candidate. The selected _AreSurfTilesLoaded path passes each retained ID to NavMeshChunkManager.IsSurfaceLoaded and returns false on its first false result. _TryApplyNavMeshState calls _ApplyNavAndMaybeUnbind only on the selected empty-list or load-check-true branch.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: The authenticated stored corpus can compare these SurfTileIDs spans with RootComp and ResourceGroup visibility spans; stored ownership does not establish any active component.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Consumer claims describe selected unpatched paths, present primitive vectors and the selected little-endian primitive read. Generic MethodSpec/code identity is static, not a live MethodInfo or executed insertion. The List.Add resize helper is outside the selected insertion proof.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Live grid/Sludge selection, patch routes, deferred callback behavior, actual navmesh state changes and physical/rendering behavior remain open.

collect.boundary: Selected collector body through its fast-path return and initialization fragments; patch target is outside.

loaded.boundary: Selected load-check body includes iteration, false/true returns and its separate patch route; the patch implementation is not proved.

tryApply.boundary: Selected caller prefix through the empty/loaded-true apply blocks; deferred-state path remains outside these claims.

primitive.boundary: Registered primitive indexed accessor through its return.

primitiveLength.boundary: Registered primitive vector length getter fast path; patch implementation is outside.

indexerClone.boundary: Unregistered indexed accessor clone with selected vector/Int32 little-endian return and initialization fragments; external error/default/byte-swap paths remain outside.

readInt.boundary: Selected Int32 helper body with byte-width/range witnesses and little-endian return; external error/byte-swap paths are outside.

carrier.boundary: Complete selected 32-byte FlatBuffer struct wrapper carrier constructor, distinct from the serialized 24-byte DataGroup extent.

listAdd.boundary: Selected List.Add body including direct qword insertion and resize tail call; resize helper implementation is outside.

listAddRegistered.boundary: Selected registered List<UInt64>.Add static candidate through both insertion/resize routes and return; live MethodInfo selection remains open.

collectorArguments.role: R9 output list to RSI, R8 Sludge wrapper to RBX, RDX grid wrapper to RDI.

clearOutput.role: Increment output list version and clear its size.

groupCarrierInputs.role: Copy Sludge ByteBuffer tail, select source position and carrier/output stack slots.

groupOffset.role: Add the proved SurfTileIDs inline offset to source position.

groupCarrierBuffer.role: Copy the same source ByteBuffer head for the carrier constructor.

groupCarrierOutput.role: Use the returned DataGroup wrapper for subsequent Num/Index reads.

carrierPosition.role: Build wrapper position EDX plus unchanged supplied ByteBuffer bytes.

carrierOutput.role: Return both 16-byte wrapper halves in the caller output slot.

groupIndexOutput.role: Pass group wrapper to get_Index and copy its returned DataIndex wrapper.

startAndGroup.role: Retain DataIndex.Index as loop start and same group receiver.

upperGuard.role: Skip indices at or above the generated vector length.

primitiveArguments.role: Pass bounded EBX index and original grid to cloned indexed accessor.

positiveGuard.role: Skip zero or negative Int32 values before conversion.

conversion.role: Pass original output list and sign-extend positive Int32 result to 64 bits.

iterationSkip.role: Loop continuation target for all bounds/value exclusions.

loopBound.role: Increment Int32 index; continue while index minus group start is below group Num.

originalSlot.role: Select the established primitive vtable slot.

cloneSlot.role: Select the same primitive vtable slot.

lengthSlot.role: Select the same primitive vtable slot for vector length.

originalStride.role: Compute primitive base plus supplied index times four.

cloneStride.role: Compute the same primitive base plus supplied index times four.

cloneAddress.role: Sign-extend byte offset and add source ByteBuffer pointer.

cloneWidth.role: Require at least four remaining bytes.

cloneRead.role: Load Int32 word from the computed ByteBuffer address.

cloneReturn.role: Return loaded Int32 word in EAX on selected little-endian path.

helperWidth.role: Require at least four remaining bytes in original Int32 helper.

helperRead.role: Load Int32 word from helper computed address.

helperReturn.role: Return loaded word in EAX on selected little-endian path.

listStore.role: Increment supplied list size and store RDX as one eight-byte value.

loadedElement.role: Pass current list qword as IsSurfaceLoaded UInt64 argument.

loadedResult.role: Continue iteration only when IsSurfaceLoaded returned true.

loadedFalse.role: Return false immediately on an unloaded surface result.

loadedTrue.role: Return true for null/empty/exhausted selected list path.

applyArguments.role: Pass same local output list, Sludge wrapper and grid wrapper to collector.

applyList.role: Pass collector output list to load check.

applyResult.role: Apply branch only when load check returned true.

emptyApply.role: Empty list bypasses load check to its separate apply block.

trueApplyArguments.role: Pass original global ID, state and receiver to apply helper.

emptyApplyArguments.role: Pass original global ID and state; receiver retained from empty-list comparison path.

registeredListStore.role: Registered candidate increments the same size field and stores the same supplied qword at stride eight.

registeredListArguments.role: Retain original context/value, items array and current Int32 list size.

countGuardInitial.role: Exit without iteration when group Num is nonpositive.

countGuardLoop.role: Exit without iteration when group Num is nonpositive.

cloneBuffer.role: Preserve source ByteBuffer head and vector byte offset.

originalBuffer.role: Preserve same source ByteBuffer carrier and vector byte offset.

cloneEndian.role: Selected Int32 return is conditional on the same little-endian flag.

helperEndian.role: Selected original Int32 helper return is conditional on the little-endian flag.

cloneEndianSource.role: Read the shared static owner of the selected little-endian flag.

helperEndianSource.role: Read the shared static owner of the selected little-endian flag.

callerInputs.role: Retain incoming state, global ID and receiver in callee-saved registers.

callerZero.role: Initialize R13d to zero before the selected empty-list comparison.

consumer.boundary: Direct conditional native control/data flow in the selected unpatched paths and selected little-endian primitive read. No live Sludge selection, successful Add resize, patch implementation or active navmesh state is certified.
